dependency_rules.name: core layers do not depend on transports

exceptions.reason: TD-002. The chat engine that serves web and native still reaches into the Telegram adapter and founder operations. Personality, writing style, and natural-command routing are product concepts filed under a transport by history, not by design. Declared so the existing violations are visible and no new one can be added silently; the register carries the exit.
